profile.title: My profile
profile.emailHint: To change your email, ask your church administrator.

security.title: Security
security.passwordDescription: We recommend a long phrase that you don't use on other sites.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices where your account is signed in. Sign out the ones you don't recognize.
security.logoutAllConfirm: You will be signed out on all your devices, including this one. Continue?

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.descriptionOff: Besides your password, we ask for a code from a phone app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar) when you sign in. Even if someone gets your password, they cannot sign in.
twoFactor.descriptionOn: When you sign in we ask for the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.requiredForPlatform: It is mandatory for the super administrator.
twoFactor.enableHelp: Scan the code with your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit number it shows.
twoFactor.regenerateHelp: The previous codes stop working. Confirm with your password.
twoFactor.disableHelp: Your account will be protected by your password only. Confirm with your password and a code from the app or a recovery code.
twoFactor.codeHelp: The 6 digits from the app or a recovery code.

codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.warning: Keep them somewhere safe: they let you sign in if you lose your phone. Each one works once and we won't show them again.
codes.fileHeader: Shaddai: two-step verification recovery codes. Each one works once.
